text: Electronic science and technology is an engineering discipline that focuses on electronic devices, integrated circuits, and electronic materials, and studies the generation, transmission, processing, and application of information. It is a "cornerstone discipline" of modern information technology industry. It integrates knowledge from multiple disciplines such as physics, materials science, and computer technology. From the microscopic arrangement of atoms in semiconductor materials to the macroscopic design of integrated circuit systems, it covers the source innovation links of the information electronics industry chain, supporting the development of strategic emerging industries such as chips, communications, artificial intelligence, and new energy.
